provenance.method: Resolved each upstream HTTPS remote with git ls-remote and recorded the exact returned commit. ML4W is pinned to tag 2.16 (lightweight tag, 3960570f47f4f691c424ff46b387d389a8e69bca), which was also the remote HEAD at verification; Gentleman.Dots is pinned to main HEAD. No ref was ever filled without verification.
provenance.command: git ls-remote https://github.com/mylinuxforwork/dotfiles.git HEAD refs/tags/2.16; git ls-remote https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/Gentleman.Dots.git HEAD refs/heads/main
